name: loose-baseline
label: Loose Baseline
profile: shipped baseline: dynamic 0.50x, 1-20c, 15c window, no widen snap-back
desc: Control. The shipped loose baseline with nothing changed; every other arm is read against it.
thesis: The shipped defaults are the reference: any arm must beat this to earn a change.
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: 11 stop exits on 40 trades -- the most filled orders in the run -- clustered between minute 194 and 268, the volatile print every arm met; this arm sets no stop mode in its env, so 5c is the shipped default threshold, not an active stop.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: the shipped 3c deadband requotes into the volatile cluster and re-enters lower; 6c holds queue position and only re-prices on a real move.

name: tight-touch
label: Tight Touch
desc: Quotes hug the mid with the tightest dynamic offset the presets ship.
thesis: A tight offset fills both legs sooner; volume and merge rate beat per-pair edge.
worst_catalyst_desc: Severe quote starvation: only 6 completed trades in 6.4h (14 fills / 30 quotes = 46.7% fill rate).
6.4 h snapshot: 14 fills on 30 quotes and only 6 merged pairs; the 0.25x offset wins the spread but leaves the second leg unreachable when the book moves.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: the aggressive 0.25x offset (2-3c) has no cushion for leg two; the balanced preset (0.50x, 2-4c) widens the acceptance window while keeping the queue.

name: balanced-mid
label: Balanced Mid
desc: The middle preset: proportional volatility tracking without the aggressive clamp.
thesis: A 2-4c band trades some edge for reach, which should merge more pairs than the wide arms.
worst_catalyst_desc: 8 stops on 33 trades (24.2%); 2-4¢ dynamic band leaves orphan legs vulnerable to fast runs.
6.4 h snapshot: two early stops at minute 194 (-$0.70) and 205 (-$0.40) landed in the same volatile cluster that hit every arm; the 2-4c offset gave up before the pair completed.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 6c deadband holds the resting quote through the volatile window instead of cancelling and re-entering at a worse price.

name: wide-shield
label: Wide Shield
desc: Widest preset offset with a loose loss stop, sized to survive volatile books.
thesis: In volatility the cushion matters more than the fill: wide offset plus an 8c stop keeps naked legs from bleeding.
worst_catalyst_desc: 9 stops on 34 trades (26.5%); 8¢ stop lets toxic orphan legs bleed deeply (-$0.37 avg loss).
worst_catalyst: 9 stop exits on 34 closes (26.5%), -$0.37 average loss
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: the widest offset did not stop the stops -- average loss per stop was -$0.37 against -$0.19 for Hair Trigger, with VaR95 at -$0.70.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: the 0.75x offset already cushions price, so an 8c stop only enlarges each loss; the shipped 5c stop cuts the tail without firing on spread noise.

name: prudent-hybrid
label: Prudent Hybrid
desc: The hybrid preset between conservative and balanced, with the preset's 4c clamp lifted to 6c so it is not the same arm as balanced.
thesis: A 0.60x multiplier is the compromise: enough cushion for swings, close enough to fill.
worst_catalyst_desc: 7 stops; $0.70 drawdown at min 193.8 during market-wide spread blowout.
worst_catalyst: Gap trade at minute 193.8: cumulative $1.19 to $0.49
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: 7 stops, worst single loss -$0.70, Sharpe 9.52 and profit factor 7.36 -- the best risk-adjusted arm; its one structural exposure is the cluster every arm met.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: no stop change is warranted; a 6c deadband is the cheapest way to turn that recurring cluster stop into a hold.

name: static-floor-2c
label: Static Floor 2c
desc: Volatility tracking switched off; every quote rests a flat 2c under the mid.
thesis: The dynamic offset is mostly noise; a fixed 2c floor should quote more consistently for less machinery.
worst_catalyst_desc: Catastrophic -$2.28 single loss at min 304.8; static 2¢ failed to widen during vol spike.
worst_catalyst: One close of -$2.28 at minute 304.8, the run's largest
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: 66 fills on 173 quotes (38.2% fill rate) and one close of -$2.28, the run's largest and about 9% worse than the next-worst -$2.10; a flat 2c offset prices a calm and a volatile book identically.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: the orphan formed because the resting quote was priced for a calm book during a volatile print; a volatility-tracking offset widens exactly then.

name: low-churn-deadband
label: Low Churn Deadband
desc: Static offset with the widest dead band config allows: almost no requoting.
thesis: Churn is the cost: holding a resting quote through small moves keeps queue position and cuts cancel/repost fees.
worst_catalyst_desc: 10 stops on 37 trades; 10¢ deadband holds stale quotes too long into adverse price shifts.
6.4 h snapshot: back-to-back losses at minute 280 (-$0.09, -$0.31) filled right after -- the 10c deadband holds a quote after the book has already moved against it.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 6c still suppresses churn on micro-moves but re-prices before a stale quote fills into an adverse book.

name: hair-trigger-2c
label: Hair Trigger 2c
profile: 2c absolute stop on a naked leg
desc: Single-leg stop armed at 2c: the earliest exit the shipped risk modes allow.
thesis: A naked leg is an unchosen bet; cutting it at 2c caps the downside before it becomes a directional loss.
worst_catalyst_desc: 15 stops on 34 trades (44.1% stop rate); premature liquidation destroys pairs on 1-tick flicker.
6.4 h snapshot: 15 stops against 19 merges -- the arm mostly stops out; average loss -$0.19 and the lowest total PnL of the active arms.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 2c is tighter than normal spread noise, so the stop fragments the pairs it means to protect; 4.5c only fires on a genuine adverse move.

name: patient-stop-9c
label: Patient Stop 9c
profile: 9c absolute stop on a naked leg
desc: Single-leg stop armed at 9c: the widest leash the tournament runs.
thesis: Most 2-5c drops are noise a hedge can still recover; a 9c stop only cuts legs that truly broke.
worst_catalyst_desc: Starvation + severe tail loss: only 6 trades, -$2.10 loss at min 360.6 degraded Sharpe to 3.38.
6.4 h snapshot: 13 fills on 24 quotes (54.2%) and no stops, but near-inactive quoting; the single -$2.10 loss (VaR95 -$2.10) erased most of the session's gains.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 9c leash is wide enough to never fire and to hold an orphan through a real break; 6c keeps the stop a circuit breaker rather than decoration.

name: queue-clear-5m
label: Queue Clear 5m
desc: Only quotes books whose queue is likely to clear inside five minutes.
thesis: A quote stuck behind a slow queue is dead capital; refusing those books should lift fill quality per order.
worst_catalyst_desc: 8 stops; 5m clear window permits fills into illiquid books right before drift (-$0.80 loss).
6.4 h snapshot: 8 stop exits, the same count as Balanced Mid, and a -$0.80 loss where the book moved right after the fill; five minutes let a slow queue turn into a bad one.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 3-minute window excludes books whose queue velocity is uncertain, trading quote count for quality per quote.
